# Chennai Central Warrenville

> Authentic South Indian Cuisine in Warrenville, Illinois

## Overview
Chennai Central Warrenville is a premier South Indian restaurant located at 28331 Dodge Dr, Warrenville, IL 60555. The menu features traditional South Indian specialties including Dum Biryani, Masala Dosa, Chettinad curries, Chicken 65, Idly & Sambar, and Madras Filter Coffee.

## Key Information
- Address: 28331 Dodge Dr, Warrenville, IL 60555
- Phone: (630) 393-6570
- Cuisine: Authentic South Indian
- Services: Lunch, Dinner, Dine-In, Takeout, Banquet & Catering
- Price Range: $$

## Operating Hours (Warrenville)
- Sunday: 11:30 AM – 9:00 PM
- Monday – Thursday: 11:30 AM – 3:00 PM (Lunch) & 5:30 PM – 10:00 PM (Dinner)
- Friday – Saturday: 11:30 AM – 1:00 AM
